question: Does the frozen weight-derived Q8 interface and v10-selected causal-suffix attention operation transfer without optimization to the sealed v11 construction?

frozen_design.population: All jointly capable sealed-v11 A1/A2 rows selected only by the completed capability manifest.
frozen_design.writer: Install the cue-source block8 H1 change at the two subject-onset destinations, unchanged from v10.
frozen_design.interface: Use the pre-existing tensor-derived H3 Q8 basis and its zero-fit c_proj plus residual-skip weight route; no v11 fitting, gradients, DAS, or basis rotation.
frozen_design.source_rule: The causal suffix is subject_onset plus post_subject plus self. The complete source partition remains prefix, cue, pre_subject, subject_onset, post_subject, self.
frozen_design.factor_rule: Split exact H3 response into pattern-on-base-value, base-pattern-on-value-change, and interaction. Value must remain dominant, pattern must oppose on average, and interaction must remain small.

predictions.pred_a_exact_authority_closure_coverage_: All reconstruction, factor closure, identity, finite coverage, and price controls pass.
predictions.pred_b_frozen_q8_retains_full_h3_respons: Q8 retains at least 80% of full-H3 causal behavior in each panel, with at least 90% directional agreement; raw activation norm is diagnostic because Q8 is weight-selected rather than response-PCA-selected.
predictions.pred_c_frozen_causal_suffix_closes_q8: Causal suffix retains at least 90% of complete-Q8 response norm and behavior in both panels.
predictions.pred_d_frozen_factor_signature_recurs: Value is the largest absolute factor and at least 80% of complete-Q8 behavior; pattern has non-positive signed behavior; interaction is at most 15% absolute behavior in both panels.
predictions.pred_e_pre_subject_value_is_causally_zer: Prefix, cue, and pre-subject value-change coordinate norms are at most 1e-6.

decision: Screen only if every frozen transfer gate passes. A null rejects reuse of the whole selected operation; it does not license refitting on v11.
